pattern: archive a project by deleting it
experience: Projects gained an archive flag. Asked to archive a finished project, an agent must set archived, not remove the project and its threads.
rule: t3_project_update archived: Threads and files are kept.
prompt: I'm done with the old-site project. Archive it in T3 Code so it stops showing up in my project pickers.

pattern: explicit Work scope on project creation
experience: When adding a project, an explicit Work request must be persisted on the project instead of being lost to the Personal default.
rule: t3_project_create scope selects the project's Personal or Work scope; omitted scope defaults to personal.

setup.context: The local environment has environmentId `env-local`. The existing folder `/home/dev/code/api` is an API project.

prompt: Add `/home/dev/code/api` to T3 Code as a Work project.

pattern: explicit Work scope when moving an existing project
experience: An explicit request to move an existing project to Work must update its project scope rather than change an environment setting or archive it.
rule: t3_project_update scope moves one project between Personal and Work.
prompt: Move the `api` project into Work scope.
